--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M376GY7KFDSK19S6JW03FKFQ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8f80
+title: AgentsTool operations and the final message through ToolContext
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §9.1 (the operations table), §9.2 (the final message). M4.
+
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolOperations.swift` with four `@Operation` types: `list agents` (`filter?`), `start agent` (`name`, `prompt`), `check agent` (`id?`), `cancel agent` (`id`). Verb aliases: `stop` → `cancel`, `run` → `start`, `status` → `check`, `show` → `list`.
+- Answers are plain text through `CorrectiveOutcome` (`.success` or `.corrective(String)`), with the texts of the §9.1 table. A correction is a text result, never a thrown error, never a post. The wrapper decodes the JSON string that `OperationTool` makes, as Skills does (plan.md §16).
+- `start agent`: read `ToolContext.current`, give it to the run, start the run as a runner task, and return at once. The run id is `completionToken`. It posts nothing during the call.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+FinalMessage.swift`: on finish the run calls `context.post(_:)` one time with a `.completed` `OperationEvent` whose `detail` is the full text. Failed: `outcome` set and "Agent `name` (`id`) failed: reason." Cancelled: "Agent `name` (`id`) was cancelled." Post, then mark the run finished.
+- Outside a Router session (`ToolContext.current == nil`) `start agent` makes its own ULID id and no final message is posted.
+- `check agent` with an id never waits. `cancel agent` gives the `CancelOutcome`. Unknown id: a corrective with the ids of this caller. (Caller isolation and `check agent` with no id come in the scheduler task.)
+- A changed agent after a reload runs with the new definition; a removed agent gives a corrective with the current names.
+- Verify (plan.md §16): a `.completed` post through a kept `ToolContext` after the call returned is journaled and staged, also with a detail longer than 4096 characters; `runSettled` is emitted with no mailbox run behind it; a post during a turn of the caller stays staged.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each success text and each corrective text of the §9.1 table, and each alias.
+- [ ] `start agent` returns before the scripted child turn ends (child gated), and posts nothing during its call.
+- [ ] The final message is the only post and holds the full text, also when longer than 4096 characters.
+- [ ] A failed run and a cancelled run each post one `.completed`.
+- [ ] The calling session emits `runSettled`, and its next prompt reads the post.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentsToolOperationsTests.swift` and `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/FinalMessageTests.swift`, with a scripted root session that calls the tool.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "AgentsToolOperationsTests|FinalMessageTests"`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
